news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Price Target to $31 from $29, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: Following Delcath's Q2 2026 beat-and-raise report, H.C. Wainwright analyst Swayampakula Ramakanth reiterated a Buy rating and lifted the price target to $31 from $29, citing continued HEPZATO commercial momentum.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up from $24.2 million a year earlier) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million, and ended the quarter with $95.9 million in cash and investments and no debt.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath announced its management team will present and hold investor meetings at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston, MA on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted RSUs totaling 17,000 shares to four new employees hired in May/June 2026 as material inducements under its 2023 Inducement Plan, vesting over three years; a routine hiring-related governance disclosure.

news.headline: Third-Party Report: HEPZATO-KIT Market Forecast to 2034 Highlights Growth Drivers and Sales Potential
news.summary: An independent market research report projected long-term sales potential and competitive positioning for HEPZATO-KIT across the seven major pharmaceutical markets (US, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK, Japan) through 2034, covering both current uveal melanoma use and potential expansion indications.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 DELUMA Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in Delcath's global DELUMA Phase 2 trial (NCT06875128), which will randomize roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer to HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone across more than 20 US/European sites.

catalysts.label: Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
catalysts.detail: Delcath management to present and hold investor meetings in Boston, MA.

catalysts.label: HEPZATO treatment center expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to roughly 37 active treatment centers by year-end 2026 (trimmed from an earlier 40-center goal) with the 40-center mark now expected in Q1 2027; over 50 additional centers reportedly in active discussions.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected roughly three months after the August 6, 2026 Q2 report, based on prior reporting cadence.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial enrollment (metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Global randomized ~90-patient trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care vs. standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; first patient dosed July 2026, with enrollment continuing across 20+ US/European sites.

catalysts.label: Pipeline/indication expansion beyond uveal melanoma
catalysts.detail: Continued clinical and commercial exploration of HEPZATO/CHEMOSAT in additional liver-dominant cancers (e.g., breast cancer, colorectal metastases) beyond the approved uveal melanoma indication.

pulse: Delcath delivered a clear beat-and-raise Q2 2026 (revenue $29.1M, +30% HEPZATO volume, guidance lifted to $104-108M, $95.9M cash with no debt), and sell-side sentiment stayed positive with H.C. Wainwright bumping its price target to $31. The DELUMA Phase 2 breast-cancer trial is now dosing patients, extending HEPZATO's reach beyond uveal melanoma, while management heads into the Canaccord Genuity conference on August 11. The main watch items are the pace of new treatment-center activations (trimmed to ~37 by year-end 2026, with 40 pushed into Q1 2027) and typical Q3/Q4 seasonal softness, but the underlying growth and pipeline trajectory remain intact.
